theorem ownConfigV_toC [package_sem : Assumptions] (cfg : GSet w64) (cfgv : tracker.Config) (prsm :
    Loc) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (pvs : GMap w64 Progress) : ownConfigV cfg cfgv prsm prs pvs ⊢
    ownConfigC (CfgM.simple cfg (prs.domSet \ cfg)) cfgv prsm prs pvs

theorem perm_elements_empty (xs : List w64) (H : xs.Perm (elements ∅)) : xs = []

theorem outgoing_sub_voters (c : CfgM) : c.outgoing ⊆ c.voters

def CfgM.ids (c : CfgM) : GSet w64 :=
  c.voters ∪ c.learners

def MajIdx (s : GSet w64) (f : w64 → w64) (N : w64) : Prop :=
  (s = ∅ → N = W64 (2 ^ 64 - 1)) ∧ (s ≠ ∅ → IsQuorumIndex s f N)

theorem ownTrackerC_progress_map [package_sem : Assumptions] (c : CfgM) (tv :
    tracker.ProgressTracker) (t : Trk) : ownTrackerC c tv t ⊢ ownMap tv.Progress' DFrac.discard
    t.prs ∗ ⌜t.prs.domSet = c.ids⌝ ∗ ownTrackerC c tv t

def ownConfigC (c : CfgM) (cfgv : tracker.Config) (prsm : Loc) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (pvs : GMap w64
    Progress) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("Hcfg" ∷ ownCfgCC cfgv (DFrac.own 1) c ∗
      "#Hprsm" ∷ ownMap prsm DFrac.discard prs ∗
        ("Hprogs" ∷ [∗map] pr;p ∈ prs;pvs, ownProgress pr p) ∗
          "%Hinv" ∷ ⌜CfgInv { cfg := c, prs := trkFlags pvs }⌝ ∗
            "%Hdom" ∷ ⌜prs.domSet = c.ids⌝ ∗ "%Hflags" ∷ ⌜LearnerFlagsC c pvs⌝ ∗ "%Hsize" ∷ ⌜↑prs.size ≤ 2 ^ 62⌝)

theorem domSet_gset (s : GSet w64) : domSet s = s

theorem wp_trackerC_progress_lookup [package_sem : Assumptions] (c : CfgM) (tv :
    tracker.ProgressTracker) (t : Trk) (i : w64) (Hi : i ∈ c.ids) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, ownTrackerC c tv t -∗ (▷
    ∀ pr, (⌜t.prs !! i = some pr⌝ ∗ ∃ p, ⌜t.peers !! i = some p⌝ ∗ ownProgress pr p ∗ ∀ p',
    ownProgress pr p' -∗ ⌜p'.learner = p.learner⌝ -∗ ownTrackerC c tv { votes := t.votes, prs :=
    t.prs, peers := <[i := p']>t.peers }) -∗ Φ (intoVal pr)) -∗ WP (((map.lookup1 go.uint64
    tracker.Progress.ty.PointerType) (intoVal tv.Progress')) (intoVal i)) {{ Φ }}

theorem ownTrackerC_simple_resimple [package_sem : Assumptions] (cfg lrn : GSet w64) (tv :
    tracker.ProgressTracker) (votes : GMap w64 Bool) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (pvs : GMap w64 Progress)
    : ownTrackerC (CfgM.simple cfg lrn) tv { votes := votes, prs := prs, peers := pvs } ⊢
    ownTrackerC (CfgM.simple cfg (prs.domSet \ cfg)) tv { votes := votes, prs := prs, peers := pvs }
    ∗ ⌜lrn = prs.domSet \ cfg⌝

theorem ids_simple (cfg : GSet w64) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (Hsub : cfg ⊆ prs.domSet) : prs.domSet =
    (CfgM.simple cfg (prs.domSet \ cfg)).ids

theorem learnerFlagsC_simple (cfg : GSet w64) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (pvs : GMap w64 Progress) (Hd : ∀
    (k : w64), (prs !! k).isSome = true ↔ (pvs !! k).isSome = true) (Hfl : LearnerFlags cfg pvs) :
    LearnerFlagsC (CfgM.simple cfg (prs.domSet \ cfg)) pvs

theorem ownTrackerC_resimple [package_sem : Assumptions] (c : CfgM) (tv : tracker.ProgressTracker)
    (t : Trk) (ho : c.outgoing = ∅) : ownTrackerC c tv t ⊢ ownTrackerC (CfgM.simple c.incoming
    (t.prs.domSet \ c.incoming)) tv t ∗ ⌜c.learners = t.prs.domSet \ c.incoming⌝

theorem size_le_of_sub_dom {V : Type} (s : GSet w64) (prs : GMap w64 V) (H : s ⊆ prs.domSet) :
    GMap.size s ≤ prs.size

theorem outgoing_sub_ids (c : CfgM) : c.outgoing ⊆ c.ids

theorem voters_sub_ids (c : CfgM) : c.voters ⊆ c.ids

theorem learners_sub_ids (c : CfgM) : c.learners ⊆ c.ids

theorem ownTrackerC_maxinflight [package_sem : Assumptions] (c : CfgM) (tv :
    tracker.ProgressTracker) (t : Trk) : ⊢ ownTrackerC c tv t -∗ ⌜0 ≤ sint.Z tv.MaxInflight' ∧
    sint.Z tv.MaxInflight' < 2 ^ 62⌝ ∗ ownTrackerC c tv t

theorem trkFlags_lookup (pvs : GMap w64 Progress) (k : w64) : trkFlags pvs !! k = Option.map (fun p
    => p.learner) (pvs !! k)

theorem cfgInv_simple (cfg : GSet w64) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (pvs : GMap w64 Progress) (Hsub : cfg ⊆
    prs.domSet) (Hd : ∀ (k : w64), (prs !! k).isSome = true ↔ (pvs !! k).isSome = true) (Hfl :
    LearnerFlags cfg pvs) : CfgInv { cfg := CfgM.simple cfg (prs.domSet \ cfg), prs := trkFlags pvs
    }

theorem ownIdsetQ_ofMaj [package_sem : Assumptions] (m : Loc) (s : GSet w64) : (⌜m = map.nil ∧ s =
    ∅⌝ ∨ ∃ ids, ⌜ids.domSet = s⌝ ∗ ownMap m (DFrac.own 1) ids) ⊢ ownIdsetQ m (DFrac.own 1) s

theorem incoming_sub_ids (c : CfgM) : c.incoming ⊆ c.ids

def ownTrackerC (c : CfgM) (tv : tracker.ProgressTracker) (t : Trk) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("Hvotes" ∷ ownMap tv.Votes' (DFrac.own 1) t.votes ∗
      "#Hprs" ∷ ownMap tv.Progress' DFrac.discard t.prs ∗
        ("Hprogs" ∷ [∗map] pr;p ∈ t.prs;t.peers, ownProgress pr p) ∗
          "Hcfg" ∷ ownCfgCC tv.Config' (DFrac.own 1) c ∗
            "%Hinv" ∷ ⌜CfgInv { cfg := c, prs := trkFlags t.peers }⌝ ∗
              "%Hdom" ∷ ⌜t.prs.domSet = c.ids⌝ ∗
                "%Hflags" ∷ ⌜LearnerFlagsC c t.peers⌝ ∗
                  "%Hsize" ∷ ⌜↑t.prs.size ≤ 2 ^ 62⌝ ∗
                    "%HmaxInfl" ∷ ⌜0 ≤ sint.Z tv.MaxInflight' ∧ sint.Z tv.MaxInflight' < 2 ^ 62⌝)

theorem ownTrackerC_cast [package_sem : Assumptions] (c : CfgM) (tv : tracker.ProgressTracker) (t t'
    : Trk) (h : t = t') : ownTrackerC c tv t ⊢ ownTrackerC c tv t'

theorem ownTrackerC_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] (c : CfgM) (tv : tracker.ProgressTracker)
    (votes : GMap w64 Bool) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (peers : GMap w64 Progress) (Hinv : CfgInv { cfg :=
    c, prs := trkFlags peers }) (Hdom : prs.domSet = c.ids) (Hflags : LearnerFlagsC c peers) (Hsize
    : ↑prs.size ≤ 2 ^ 62) (HmaxInfl : 0 ≤ sint.Z tv.MaxInflight' ∧ sint.Z tv.MaxInflight' < 2 ^ 62)
    : ⊢ ownMap tv.Votes' (DFrac.own 1) votes -∗ ownMap tv.Progress' DFrac.discard prs -∗ ([∗map]
    pr;p ∈ prs;peers, ownProgress pr p) -∗ ownCfgCC tv.Config' (DFrac.own 1) c -∗ ownTrackerC c tv {
    votes := votes, prs := prs, peers := peers }

def visitClosureC (c : CfgM) (trk : Loc) (votes : GMap w64 Bool) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (f : GoFunc)
    (I : GSet w64 → GMap w64 Progress → IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ i pr tv pvs p D,
      □
        ∀ Φ,
          ⌜i ∈ prs.domSet⌝ ∗
              ⌜prs !! i = some pr⌝ ∗
                ⌜pvs !! i = some p⌝ ∗
                  ⌜0 ≤ sint.Z tv.MaxInflight' ∧ sint.Z tv.MaxInflight' < 2 ^ 62⌝ ∗
                    typedPointsto trk tv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                      ownProgress pr p ∗
                        (∀ p',
                            ownProgress pr p' -∗
                              ⌜p'.learner = p.learner⌝ -∗
                                ownTrackerC c tv { votes := votes, prs := prs, peers := <[i := p']>pvs }) ∗
                          I D pvs -∗
            ▷
                ((∃ tv' pvs',
                    typedPointsto trk tv' (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                      ownTrackerC c tv' { votes := votes, prs := prs, peers := pvs' } ∗ I ({i} ∪ D) pvs') -∗
                  Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
              WP (((intoVal f) (intoVal i)) (intoVal pr)) {{ Φ }})

theorem ownCfgCC_voters [package_sem : Assumptions] (cfg : tracker.Config) (c : CfgM) : ownCfgCC cfg
    (DFrac.own 1) c ⊢ ∃ vin vout, ⌜cfg.Voters'.arr = [vin, vout]⌝ ∗ ownIdsetQ vin (DFrac.own 1)
    c.incoming ∗ ownIdsetQ vout (DFrac.own 1) c.outgoing ∗ (ownIdsetQ vin (DFrac.own 1) c.incoming
    -∗ ownIdsetQ vout (DFrac.own 1) c.outgoing -∗ ownCfgCC cfg (DFrac.own 1) c)

theorem ownTrackerC_voters_size [package_sem : Assumptions] (c : CfgM) (tv :
    tracker.ProgressTracker) (t : Trk) : ownTrackerC c tv t ⊢ ⌜↑(GMap.size c.voters) ≤ 2 ^ 62 ∧
    ↑(GMap.size c.incoming) ≤ 2 ^ 62 ∧ ↑(GMap.size c.outgoing) ≤ 2 ^ 62⌝ ∗ ownTrackerC c tv t

theorem ownTrackerC_autoleave [package_sem : Assumptions] (c : CfgM) (tv : tracker.ProgressTracker)
    (t : Trk) : ownTrackerC c tv t ⊢ ⌜tv.Config'.AutoLeave' = c.autoLeave⌝ ∗ ownTrackerC c tv t

theorem learnersNext_sub_ids (c : CfgM) (prs : GMap w64 Bool) (H : CfgInv { cfg := c, prs := prs })
    : c.learnersNext ⊆ c.ids

theorem ownTrackerC_lookup_same [package_sem : Assumptions] (c : CfgM) (tv :
    tracker.ProgressTracker) (t : Trk) (i : w64) (pr : Loc) (Hpr : t.prs !! i = some pr) : ⊢
    ownTrackerC c tv t -∗ ∃ p, ⌜t.peers !! i = some p⌝ ∗ ownProgress pr p ∗ (ownProgress pr p -∗
    ownTrackerC c tv t)

theorem ownIdsetQ_toMaj [package_sem : Assumptions] (m : Loc) (s : GSet w64) : ownIdsetQ m
    (DFrac.own 1) s ⊢ ⌜m = map.nil ∧ s = ∅⌝ ∨ ∃ ids, ⌜ids.domSet = s⌝ ∗ ownMap m (DFrac.own 1) ids

def LearnerFlagsC (c : CfgM) (pvs : GMap w64 Progress) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : w64) (p : Progress), pvs !! k = some p → p.learner = decide (k ∈ c.learners)

def trkFlags (pvs : GMap w64 Progress) : GMap w64 Bool :=
  GMap.fmap (fun p => p.learner) pvs

theorem learners_of_C (c : CfgM) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (f : GMap w64 Bool) (Hinv : CfgInv { cfg := c,
    prs := f }) (Hdom : prs.domSet = c.ids) (ho : c.outgoing = ∅) : c.learners = prs.domSet \
    c.incoming

theorem LearnerFlagsC.insert {c : CfgM} {pvs : GMap w64 Progress} {k : w64} {p p' : Progress} (H :
    LearnerFlagsC c pvs) (Hp : pvs !! k = some p) (Hl : p'.learner = p.learner) : LearnerFlagsC c
    <[k := p']>pvs

theorem ownTrackerC_pure [package_sem : Assumptions] (c : CfgM) (tv : tracker.ProgressTracker) (t :
    Trk) : ownTrackerC c tv t ⊢ ⌜CfgInv { cfg := c, prs := trkFlags t.peers } ∧ t.prs.domSet = c.ids
    ∧ LearnerFlagsC c t.peers ∧ ↑t.prs.size ≤ 2 ^ 62 ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z tv.MaxInflight' ∧ sint.Z
    tv.MaxInflight' < 2 ^ 62⌝ ∗ ownTrackerC c tv t

theorem ownTrackerC_lookup [package_sem : Assumptions] (c : CfgM) (tv : tracker.ProgressTracker) (t
    : Trk) (i : w64) (pr : Loc) (Hpr : t.prs !! i = some pr) : ⊢ ownTrackerC c tv t -∗ ∃ p, ⌜t.peers
    !! i = some p⌝ ∗ ownProgress pr p ∗ ∀ p', ownProgress pr p' -∗ ⌜p'.learner = p.learner⌝ -∗
    ownTrackerC c tv { votes := t.votes, prs := t.prs, peers := <[i := p']>t.peers }

theorem ownTrackerC_reconfig [package_sem : Assumptions] (c : CfgM) (tv : tracker.ProgressTracker)
    (votes : GMap w64 Bool) (cfgv : tracker.Config) (prsm : Loc) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (pvs : GMap
    w64 Progress) (Hmi : 0 ≤ sint.Z tv.MaxInflight' ∧ sint.Z tv.MaxInflight' < 2 ^ 62) : ⊢ ownMap
    tv.Votes' (DFrac.own 1) votes -∗ ownConfigC c cfgv prsm prs pvs -∗ ownTrackerC c { Config' :=
    cfgv, Progress' := prsm, Votes' := tv.Votes', MaxInflight' := tv.MaxInflight', MaxInflightBytes'
    := tv.MaxInflightBytes' } { votes := votes, prs := prs, peers := pvs }

theorem ownTrackerC_empty [package_sem : Assumptions] (tv : tracker.ProgressTracker) (v0 : Loc)
    (Harr : tv.Config'.Voters'.arr = [v0, map.nil]) (Hl : tv.Config'.Learners' = map.nil) (Hln :
    tv.Config'.LearnersNext' = map.nil) (Hal : tv.Config'.AutoLeave' = false) (Hmi : 0 ≤ sint.Z
    tv.MaxInflight' ∧ sint.Z tv.MaxInflight' < 2 ^ 62) : ⊢ ownMap v0 (DFrac.own 1) ∅ -∗ ownMap
    tv.Votes' (DFrac.own 1) ∅ -∗ ownMap tv.Progress' DFrac.discard ∅ -∗ ownTrackerC (CfgM.simple ∅
    ∅) tv { votes := ∅, prs := ∅, peers := ∅ }

theorem incoming_sub_voters (c : CfgM) : c.incoming ⊆ c.voters

def JCommittedIdx (s0 s1 : GSet w64) (f : w64 → w64) (N : w64) : Prop :=
  ∃ N0 N1, MajIdx s0 f N0 ∧ MajIdx s1 f N1 ∧ N = if uint.Z N0 < uint.Z N1 then N0 else N1

theorem ownTrackerC_votes [package_sem : Assumptions] (c : CfgM) (tv : tracker.ProgressTracker) (t :
    Trk) : ownTrackerC c tv t ⊢ ownMap tv.Votes' (DFrac.own 1) t.votes ∗ ⌜0 ≤ sint.Z tv.MaxInflight'
    ∧ sint.Z tv.MaxInflight' < 2 ^ 62⌝

theorem ownTrackerC_prvals_dom [package_sem : Assumptions] (c : CfgM) (tv : tracker.ProgressTracker)
    (t : Trk) : ⊢ ownTrackerC c tv t -∗ ⌜t.peers.domSet = t.prs.domSet⌝ ∗ ownTrackerC c tv t

theorem trkFlags_insert_same (pvs : GMap w64 Progress) (k : w64) (p p' : Progress) (Hp : pvs !! k =
    some p) (Hl : p'.learner = p.learner) : trkFlags <[k := p']>pvs = trkFlags pvs
